scenarios.name: add
scenarios.doc: The colour bulb's address is typed in: the entry is made and set up.

scenarios.name: pick
scenarios.doc: No address: discovery lists the colour and the white bulb, the white one is picked, after what the form refuses.

scenarios.name: pick_none
scenarios.doc: No address, and no bulb answers discovery.

scenarios.name: typed_fails
scenarios.doc: An address where nothing answers, then a LIFX Switch, then what the form refuses.

scenarios.name: pick_gone
scenarios.doc: A bulb that answers discovery and then nothing more is picked.

scenarios.name: configured
scenarios.doc: With the colour bulb set up: its address again; discovery, which leaves it out; then its new address, which moves the entry there.

scenarios.name: not_ready
scenarios.doc: Once the flow has the colour bulb's label, another bulb answers at its address: the entry waits for a retry, and is removed.
